Criterion stated by the authors: clean replay in a fresh container passes setup + doctor + minimal_verify (per repository); no success threshold on the rate. Generation cost: authors call it 'acceptable', comparable to manual setup. -- (1) BootstrapAgent + own multi-agent pipeline + DeepSeek-V4-Flash-2026-04-25 (temperature 1.0): success 197/212 (92.9%): ExecutionAgent 42/50, Installamatic 38/40, Repo2Run 117/122; median 43.8K tokens, 24.6 min per repository (P90 169.2K, 79.0 min). Quality: works per the authors' clean-replay criterion ('effective for building most repositories'); cost: works per the authors' own statement ('acceptable', one-off). -- (2) HerAgent (baseline; strongest reported baseline, agent/model not stated in this paper; whether re-run under the same verifier not stated): 179/212 (84.4%): 41/50, 34/40, 104/122. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors (unclear whether the clean-replay criterion was applied); cost: not reported. -- (3) Downstream Claude Code (headless, model not stated) cold, without .bootstrap but given the same verification commands (baseline): median wall time 346.3 s overall (ExecutionAgent 285.2 / Installamatic 337.8 / Repo2Run 391.9 s); median active tokens 46.3K (38.9K / 41.6K / 50.8K); total tokens 710.7K (597.9K / 594.4K / 797.8K). Quality: not reported (downstream success not reported); cost: no criterion stated by the authors. -- (4) Downstream Claude Code warm, with .bootstrap: median wall time 249.5 s (112.0 / 282.3 / 309.8 s); median active tokens 36.9K (19.6K / 36.6K / 43.1K); total tokens 419.4K (115.7K / 312.6K / 526.9K). Quality: not reported; cost: no criterion stated by the authors. -- Ablations (Repo2Run / ExecutionAgent / Installamatic success; full 95.9% / 84.0% / 95.0%): (5) w/o repository discovery (ablation) 76.2% / 52.0% / 70.0%; (6) w/o clean replay (ablation) 95.1% / 82.0% / 90.0%; (7) w/o trace-driven repair (ablation) 26.2% / 18.0% / 40.0%; (8) w/o warm-state repair (ablation): +4,839.9 / +851.6 / +421.9 min total time; (9) w/o sanity check (ablation): 5/122, 4/50, 2/40 false positives caught by the full system. Quality and cost for ablations: no criterion stated by the authors

Tasks: 212 repositories from 3 public benchmarks. Configurations: BootstrapAgent vs HerAgent (strongest reported baseline; whether re-run is Not stated); downstream Claude Code cold vs warm (paired, same project, same verification commands); component ablations. Held constant: Docker Ubuntu 24.04 image, budgets (20 repair rounds, 3600 s), downstream timeout 1800 s and API budget 3 USD. Acceptance tests: clean replay with minimal verification command chosen by the system itself. Repetitions: 1 run per project and condition. Human intervention: none

BootstrapAgent +8.5 points over HerAgent (92.9% vs 84.4%; +10.1% relative). Warm downstream: median time -28% overall (largest on ExecutionAgent 0.39x), median tokens -20%, total tokens -41%. Trace-driven repair is the largest contributor (-55 to -70 points without it). No significance tests

Distinguished BootstrapAgent from HerAgent and cold vs warm on cost; single run per condition; no variance. Limitations stated: local bootstrap readiness only, not full CI or semantic correctness; contracts need maintenance

Establishes local bootstrap readiness, not full CI reproduction or semantic correctness; .bootstrap must be maintained as the project evolves; risk of over-trusting contracts (transient workarounds, weak validation); failures from missing or inconsistent version information. Future: stronger dependency solving, historical environment inference, external artifact recovery, repositories needing services, GPUs, large integration tests
